title: GRC Relationship
description: Interactive three-circle Venn diagram (Governance, Risk, Compliance) rendered as inline SVG with hover tooltips on every region and overlap, including the central Security Program. Stacks vertically on narrow screens.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Distinguish governance, risk, and compliance as three related but distinct functions.
Explain what each pairwise overlap (and the central Security Program) represents.
Articulate why an organization can be compliant yet still insecure.
educational.prerequisites: Awareness that organizations face regulations and must manage risk.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions ask students to place real activities in the correct region and to defend the caption.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating compliance as equivalent to security.
Conflating governance (who decides) with risk management (what could go wrong).
